scope: Admin UI moves from the name-addressed Profile admin routes to the pair-addressed Connection admin API (D18). Tests that pinned listProfiles, setApiKey, deleteProfile, deleteProfileAction, the default-name fallback, the Name and Label columns and the Profile name field are rewritten to listConnections, setConnectionApiKey, deleteConnection, deleteConnectionAction, the Key hint column and a form without a name. The protective invariants carry over unchanged: write-only key, secret scrub, encoded path segments, arm-before-delete, bug rethrow, success-only revalidation, body exactly {api_key}, nothing upstream-derived in a log line.
reason: Owner decision 2026-10-14: remove the legacy UI code instead of keeping it beside the new code, and rewrite the prior tests to the new contract (spec docs/spec/2026-10-02-provider-credential-admin-contract.md section 8 requires removing the name field, the Name column, name bindings and the default fallback).
